dispatch_architecture.id_table: {name_ptr, vfunc_offset, 0} stride-12, SORTED by name; dispatcher binary-searches name, then calls *(service_obj.vtable + id) via bctrl (m9 dispatcher @0x10823970; id&1 selects the virtual path, all observed ids odd). Actions are C++ virtual methods on the service object — a DIFFERENT mechanism than ptr-table. Used by SystemProperties, ZoneGroupTopology, AlarmClock, ConnectionManager, MusicServices (and HTControl on model-9).

universal_dispatcher.decompiled_proof: m8 and m9 per-service dispatchers are semantically identical C. The 'two dispatch formats' resolve to ONE polymorphic record format {name_ptr, fn_or_id, ctx_off}, stride 3, binary-searched.

semantics.stub_path: worker==0 OR action-name not found -> req->vfunc(+0x14)(req, 0x191=401). This is the AudioIn/HTControl stub mechanism.
semantics.discriminator: rec[1]&1: clear -> C fn ptr; set -> vtable-id (impl = *( *(svc_ctx+rec[2]).vtable + (rec[1]&~1) ))
semantics.call_sig: impl(svc_ctx + rec[2], req, worker) — rec[2] selects sub-object 'this' within service context

universal_dispatcher.note: vtable-ids are ODD byte-offsets (e.g. 41) because low bit is the flag; actual slot = id>>1 in pointer units (id is byte offset |1)
universal_dispatcher.evolution: Same mechanism since 34.16: 12-byte {name,fn_or_id,ctx_off} records, &1 discriminator (clear=direct C call; set=vtable-id via *(base+ctx_off).vtable[id]), 0x191 not-found fault. Difference: 34.16/57.x used libc bsearch(nmemb,size=12,cmp) + service-URN-keyed lookup; 86.x uses a hand-rolled inline binary search with identical semantics (m8 FUN_10752428 / m9 FUN_1082b0fc).
universal_dispatcher.34.16_proof: ZGT dispatcher @0x101b0ccc: bsearch(0x103a2f30,8,12,cmp=0x101b0444); then lwz rec[1],rec[2]; andi. &1 -> direct or vtable call; 0x191 fault on miss. GetZoneGroupState id=0x25 (vs 41 in 86.x — different vtable layout, same mechanism).

object_model.aggregate: zone-player C++ object (~28KB) embeds 16 UPnP service objects at a fixed 0x680-byte stride; wired by FUN_10771084 (strcmp on service URN -> member offset) and controlURL lookup FUN_1075c668
object_model.service_struct: 0x680-byte UpnpService object; +0x00 vtable (dispatch at vfunc+0x40, called by master dispatcher); delegates to embedded svc_ctx impl descriptor

svc_ctx.layout: 12-byte object {vtable@+0, worker@+4, refcounted_impl@+8}; vtable = {+0 dtor, +4 deleting-dtor(operator_delete(obj,0xc)), +8 table-dispatcher}
svc_ctx.placement: members of zp aggregate at consecutive word-offsets 0xcb54..0xcb66 stride 3 (bytes 0x32d50,0x32d68,0x32d74,0x32d8c,0x32d98...) = the ROUTE HANDLER objects; route dispatcher calls handler->vfunc+0x08 = the table dispatcher
svc_ctx.ctor: FUN_10754790 (RC instance) zeroes worker/+8, stores 3-slot descriptor vtable (located in .rodata immediately before the service's action table)
svc_ctx.worker: delegate/impl object — NOT set in ctor; bound post-construction during device init (runtime-dependent). null -> 0x191(401) at dispatch. Called as worker->vfunc+0x1c(...) by SetVolume-class impls.
svc_ctx.dispatch_chain: HTTP req -> FUN_101875f4 route table (enable byte) -> svc_ctx->vfunc+0x08 = FUN_10752428 binary-search {name,fn_or_id,ctx_off} -> impl(svc_ctx+ctx_off, req, worker=svc_ctx+4). FUN_10670ee4 = separate UPnP/secure/proxy dispatcher on the 0x680-byte UpnpService objects (vfunc+0x40) for the device-description/eventing hierarchy.

object_model.dispatch_chain: route thunk -> FUN_10670ee4 (master: SOAPAction parse, secure checks, x-sonos-target-udn proxy) -> service_obj->vfunc+0x40 -> svc_ctx->vfunc+0x08 (FUN_10752428 table dispatch) -> impl(svc_ctx+ctx_off, req, worker)
object_model.fault_codes: req->vfunc+0x14(code) raises a SOAP fault whose numeric code IS the UPnP error code: 0x191=401 'Invalid Action' (unknown/missed action), 0x192=402 'Invalid Args' (arg-parse failure, e.g. SetVolume bad input). HTTP/GENA layer reuses same constants: 0x193=403, 0x19a=410, 0x19c=412, 0x1f5=501, 0x1f7=503.

impl_obj_vtable.layout: impl-object vtable = {dtor@+0, deleting-dtor@+4, table-dispatch@+0x08, [virtual action methods]}; sits in .rodata immediately before the service's {name,fn_or_id,ctx_off} action table
impl_obj_vtable.size_varies: 3 slots only for all-ptr-table services (RC etc: action impls live in the table, not the vtable); larger for id-table services whose actions ARE virtual methods

zgt_impl_vtable.m8: 0x10c6f618 (11 slots; 8 action methods at slots 3-10 == ids 13,17,21,25,29,33,37,41)

impl_obj_vtable.idtable_dispatch: 2-arg call method(impl_obj+ctx_off, req); no dispatcher-side worker check; the virtual method reads *(this+4)=worker and calls worker->vfunc+SLOT itself

dsp_eq_variants.fenway: FUN_10b95dec = Play:1 EQ-variant selector driven by the hardware descriptor: 0xe->ROYALE (or 'BEACON RollBack' if hwrev(FUN_108d2d70)>=7), {0xf,0x14,0x18,0x28,0x2d}->BOOTLEG, 0x16->MARQUEE, 0x17->LARGO, default->AMOEBA. Internal codenames = per-hardware-revision DSP tuning curves.
dsp_eq_variants.limelight: ABSENT — no EQ-variant selector or codenames; Playbar uses a single fixed equalization (only generic 'Bad equalizer band' error string exists).
dsp_eq_variants.sub_backend: FUN_10b968e4 DSPControlSub 'Updating subwoofer level': writes level to obj+0x1540 + flag +0x1544, commits via vfunc+0x15c — the Sub volume path behind the SOAP worker delegate.

http_route_table.entry_layout: {handler_obj, path, svc_name, flag_bit, enable_byte} stride 5 words; loop strcmp path; skipped when enable_byte==0 -> default handler (404); flag_bit & *(zp+telemetry_mask) -> emits {service,method} metrics

htcontrol_route.m8: ABSENT — '/HTControl/Control' string exists but has zero code refs; not in the route table -> HTTP 404 at route layer

http_route_table.correction: HTControl on fenway is fully absent: no route binding (404, not even SOAP 401), no action table, no impl code. Only the service object (zp-member +0x3b14) and advertised URN/SCPD persist via shared device-description data.
http_route_table.shared_enable_byte: most routes share a single global UPnP-enable flag (*(zp+0x53e4)^1 on m8, *(zp+0x544c)^1 on m9); AudioIn has its own runtime byte *(zp+0x53cc)

gena_eventing.dispatcher: FUN_1066bc50 — all /.../Event endpoints; method codes: 0xb=SUBSCRIBE, 0xc=UNSUBSCRIBE, other->0x1f5(501)
gena_eventing.secure_gate: DeviceProperties/Event and GroupManagement/Event EXEMPT from security check; all other event paths require FUN_1066bb58 + ctx field -> else 'UPnP Eventing denied. 403 Forbidden' = 0x193

subscribe.new: requires callback '<url>' (<=0x400 bytes) + nt='upnp:event' + no sid -> FUN_1065bd74 creates sub -> 200 + SID + 'TIMEOUT: Second-%u' + initial event burst via vfunc+0xa0->FUN_10656010
subscribe.renew: sid present, no nt/callback -> FUN_10659514 -> 200 + TIMEOUT; missing/invalid sid -> 0x19c(412)

gena_eventing.unsubscribe: no nt/callback + sid -> FUN_10658d58 -> 200; bad form -> 400 or 0x19c
gena_eventing.timeout: default & max 0x15180=86400s (24h); 'Second-N' clamped 1..86400 then capped by global DAT_10d9645c
gena_eventing.secure_check_detail: FUN_1066bb58: conn->vfunc+0x5c fetches session/security ctx (shared_ptr); no ctx -> deny(403); ctx -> allow = !ctx->vfunc+0x24(). DeviceProperties+GroupManagement events exempt.

statevar_model.storage: named state-var node tree at worker_obj+0x498; FUN_1055b0cc(tree,name,0) = find-or-create node; value set via node->vfunc+0x10(val)
statevar_model.lastchange: event emission writes named nodes (InstanceID, CurrentURI, CurrentURIMetaData...) into the tree, then serializes to e:propertyset/LastChange XML for subscribers (FUN_10656010 initial-burst on subscribe)

req_vtable_ext.+0x24: output-arg accessor — returns out-arg object; its vfunc+0x10 sets the value (e.g. PlayMode, RecQualityMode)
req_vtable_ext.+0x20: input-arg variant used by some impls

chsnk_state_machine.function: FUN_1036b340 (chsnk.cxx) — CHSNK receiver run loop (~0x29c0-byte receiver object)
chsnk_state_machine.states: obj+0x2880 = state (1..9) via handler table DAT_10c18b68: stopped(1)->condvar wait FUN_108d78b8(obj+0x218); 3='chsnk playing local chsrc'; 5='chsnk playing local AI'; 'local VLI'; 'remote chsrc at %d.%06d' — per-source branches call FUN_104c0e18(obj+0x2b8) + FUN_103697f0(obj,state) + FUN_1061a4ac(&sub, obj+0x2b0, N) + FUN_10479988(obj+0x1be8, sub)
findings: AudioIn IS a live internal CHSNK source (handler 5) in m8 despite the SOAP AudioIn surface being stubbed — shared codebase carries the path
'Chsnk restart requested by new coordinator to avoid seamless delegation' — group-coordinator CHSNK handoff semantics
chsnk_state_machine.infra: netstartd IPC (/tmp/netstartd.ipc, /var/run/netstart_mode), SonosNet mesh mgmt (NETMODE_SONOSNET_WIRED/WIRELESS, disable test-mode auto-revert), hwmessagelib event channel, protobuf node req/resp (nodetx telemetry: nodetx_chsrc/nodetx_vli, <NodeTXBuffer>), 7-field TLV header

impl_convention.pattern: Every ptr-table action impl is a thin wrapper: for each in-arg v=req->vfunc+0x1c(name) + typed parse helper (FUN_1055a768=int, FUN_1055a7c0=string-into-0x400-buf, FUN_1055a710=scalar); then req->vfunc+0x8 parse-gate -> 0x192(402 Invalid Args) on fail; else worker->vfunc+SLOT(parsed...) delegate; fault==0 -> req->vfunc+0xc commit else req->vfunc+0x14(fault) raise.
impl_convention.worker_slots: per-service worker vtable layout: RC SetVolume=+0x1c, AVT Play=+0x2c, GetTransportSettings=+0x20 (multi-out); output args via req->vfunc+0x24->outarg->vfunc+0x10
verified_on: RenderingControl SetVolume (m8 FUN_10753c48 == m9 FUN_1082ca5c semantically identical)
ZGT GetZoneGroupState id-table virtual impl (m8 FUN_1074b910 == m9 FUN_10823850; worker->vfunc+0x28)
impl_convention.idtable_variant: id-table actions are virtual methods on the impl object called as method(this+ctx_off, req); they read *(this+4)=worker and delegate worker->vfunc+SLOT just like ptr-table impls

arg_descriptors.layout: arg-value object filled by per-type helpers: {+0x04 type_tag, +0x08 source, +0x0c storage_ptr, +0x10 capacity, +0x14 flags, +0x31 parsed}
arg_descriptors.validation: req->vfunc+0x8 performs whole-request conversion; failure -> 0x192(402). Descriptors carry NO range/enum constraint list — dispatch-time validation is TYPE+CAPACITY only; SCPD enums/ranges are metadata, enforcement is in worker/delegate code.
arg_descriptors.caps: strings bounded to 0x400 (1024B); scalars to 0x18 (24B) inline — explains buf_cap extraction limitation (caps live in these descriptors, not tables)

idtable_impl_proof.mechanism: id-table entries dispatch as virtual methods ON the impl object (not free C fns). method = *(impl_obj.vtable + (id & ~1)); called method(ctx+off, req).
idtable_impl_proof.worker_delegate: id-table impls ALSO delegate through this+4=worker -> worker->vfunc+SLOT (same backend-delegate architecture as ptr-table). ZGT GetZoneGroupState uses worker->vfunc+0x28.

getzonegroupstate.identical: instruction-identical shape in both binaries: req->vfunc+0x3c begin/telemetry -> req->vfunc+0x8 parse (0x192 on fail) -> worker->vfunc+0x28 builds ZoneGroupState XML -> req->vfunc+0x24('ZoneGroupState') out-arg -> out->vfunc+0x10 write -> req->vfunc+0xc commit. Same worker slot +0x28 = same ZGT backend interface = same source.

request_object_vtable.address_point: 0x10c334d8 (m8, .rodata); resolved by anchoring vfunc+0x24=0x104999c4 (out-arg accessor, queries req+0x994 parsed-body arg list)

slots.+0x14: 0x100c859c raise fault (SOAP fault XML via 0x1049eb68 <s:Fault> builder)

request_object_vtable.validator_semantics: vfunc+0x08 = FUN_1049e9e8 -> FUN_100ca658. Returns status codes 0x33(ok)/0x3e(denied)/0x3fe(mode). Enforces a group-'Master'-coordinator authorization gate (req->vfunc+0x1c/+0xc 'Master' checks) + session sub-object capability query (vfunc+0x5c). It is a precondition/authorization gate, NOT a per-arg type parser - type conversion is done by the descriptor machinery (vfunc+0x1c accessor + typed helpers FUN_1055a768 int/FUN_1055a7c0 string) reading req+0x994.
request_object_vtable.note: 0x192 'Invalid Args' can therefore be raised for authorization/precondition denial, not only malformed args. Whether this exact vtable is universal or an AVTransport/RC-specific request subclass is unresolved - the 'Master' gating is consistent with group-coordinator enforcement but may be service-scoped.

request_context_class.finding: the 'req' object passed to every impl is a polymorphic per-service request-context subclass sharing ONE SOAP-request base vtable. 3 sibling vtables confirmed (0x10be20b8, 0x10c3a640, 0x10c334d8) with identical base-class methods in fixed slots and differing subclass overrides.
request_context_class.shared_base_vfuncs: 0x1049e9e8@+0x08 validate/authorize; 0x100c8f84 commit; 0x100c859c fault; 0x1049eb68 in-accessor; 0x104999c4@+0x24 out-accessor; 0x100b9444@+0x38 finalize; 0x100c8534@+0x3c begin; shared 0x100ca658(Master-gate), 0x100c8e90, 0x100e0958, 0x10657af0, 0x100c8d60, 0x10657b74
request_context_class.implication: uniform vfunc-offset contract across all 204 impls exists because every service's request context derives from the same SOAP base; the +0x08 validator is a Master-coordinator authorization gate inherited by all services
request_context_class.volume_backend: FUN_100cef4c (clamp[0,100], 'Cannot set volume in fixed output mode', audio obj vfunc+0xe0/+0xe4) is a shared volume backend method present in all 3 sibling vtables - base-class audio-volume op
request_context_class.worker_identity: the product backend (worker@svc_ctx+4) remains bound post-construction at runtime - not statically resolvable; subclass vtables differ in override slots (e.g. 0x10505xxx vs 0x100d9xxx) suggesting per-service request subclasses
request_context_class.m9_parity: m9 volume backend 0x100dc8e8 == m8 FUN_100cef4c (same 'fixed output mode' check, same audio-object vfunc+0xe0 get / +0xe4 interface). Request-context subclass architecture is cross-model identical.
request_context_class.m9_extra: m9 carries an extra source unit rc_impl_stp.cxx / rc_impl_stp (state-template variant) alongside rc_impl.cxx; m8 has only rc_impl.cxx - a limelight-only RC submodule consistent with its HT/group-master role

request_plumbing_evolution.finding: the SOAP request-object vtable abstraction (req->vfunc+0x08/+0x14/+0x24/+0x0c/+0x38/+0x3c) was introduced BETWEEN 57.10 and 86.x. In 57.10 the equivalent ops are direct free-function calls (parse FUN_10380aa4, fault FUN_10380fc8, out-accessor FUN_10366098 on req+0x5fc, commit FUN_10380c24).
request_plumbing_evolution.conserved_across_all: worker@this+4 -> worker->vfunc+SLOT backend delegate; 0x191/0x192 fault constants; out->vfunc+0x10 output write; 'ZoneGroupState' output arg; impl-object vtable {lifecycle,dispatch@slot2,action-methods} ending right before the {name,id,ctx} table
request_plumbing_evolution.getzonegroupstate_5710: impl 0x10384a44 (id41->impl vtable slot10, vtable ends 0x10524bb8); ZGT dispatcher 0x10384390 = hand-rolled binary search (lo/hi/mid, mid*12 stride) + andi.0x1 low-bit test + 0x191 miss + *(ctx+0x70) trace - IDENTICAL mechanism to 86.x, only request-op plumbing differs

evolution_chain.34.16: libc bsearch + low-bit id + direct-call plumbing
evolution_chain.57.10: inline binary search + low-bit id + direct-call plumbing
evolution_chain.86.x: inline binary search + low-bit id + virtualized request-object vfuncs

request_plumbing_evolution.interpretation: backend-delegate + action-method + output-arg architecture is ancient (>=34.x); only the request plumbing was virtualized into a polymorphic request-context class by 86.x (enabling per-service request subclasses)

worker_identity_unresolved.evidence: worker@svc_ctx+4 is NULL in the svc_ctx ctor (FUN_10754790) and bound post-construction during device init. No operator_new+store@+4 pattern found (workers are likely embedded members of the zone-player aggregate or device objects, bound via computed offsets in init code). DSPControlPlay1/Play3/Sub class names appear only as log/registration strings with no code xrefs to a ctor/factory.
worker_identity_unresolved.what_is_proven: the backend-delegate interface is uniform: impls call worker->vfunc+SLOT (SetVolume->+0x1c, Play->+0x2c, GetZoneGroupState->+0x28). The shared volume backend FUN_100cef4c(m8)/0x100dc8e8(m9) calls the audio object via vfunc+0xe0/+0xe4. Whether all services share one ZonePlayer backend or per-service workers is unresolved statically.
worker_identity_unresolved.distinction: the 'req' object (SOAP plumbing, per-service request-context subclass) and the 'worker' (product audio/zone backend) are SEPARATE objects - conflating them is an error; only the former is statically mappable

refined.worker_family: located the DSPControl-family worker vtables at 0x10d28xxx-0x10d2fxxx: multiple sibling classes share one large audio-backend method block ({0x10b911e8,0x10b913d8,...} and {0x10b90fc0,0x10b906d0,...} base blocks), differing only in leading override slots - the DSPControl{Play1,Play3,Sub,HT} siblings inheriting a common DSP-control base
refined.facade: worker methods are thin delegate trampolines: e.g. reads this->sub@0x158 -> inner@0x714 -> vfunc+0x10, forwarding to deeper audio/DSP sub-objects. The concrete sibling is product-selected at runtime via the hwmodel gate (why class names have no ctor xref - selection is data-driven)
refined.conclusion: worker = a DSPControl-family facade class sharing a common backend interface (worker->vfunc+SLOT). Which concrete sibling (Play1 vs Play3 vs Sub vs HT) backs each service is runtime-selected; the family + shared interface is now statically mapped

worker_identity_unresolved.m9_parity: m9 has the same polymorphic backend-class architecture: 466 .rodata vtable runs including large shared-tail families (39,17,8-member hierarchies) = sibling classes sharing base method blocks. Same DSPControl-family facade structure.

netstart_ipc_protocol.transport: custom Sonos IPC over Unix socket /tmp/netstartd.ipc via InitializeIPCContext(ctx,2,name)/CloseIPCContext (ipc_msg.cxx). Not a raw socket - an internal IPC framework.
netstart_ipc_protocol.connection: FUN_105be44c establishes: InitializeIPCContext -> on success log 'IPC established for %s', status=0x3c(60), send 'hello' handshake via obj->vfunc+0x40; on fail status=5 'Error starting IPC for %s (rc=%d)'. IPC fd at obj[99], -1=closed.
netstart_ipc_protocol.request_shape: FUN_105be618: writes method name to obj+0x1a (strlcpy cap 0x6c), locks mutex at obj+0x88, FUN_105be44c does the call, then async callback arg->vfunc+0x08(result).
netstart_ipc_protocol.mode_query: FUN_106697f0 reads /var/run/netstart_mode as int via sonosFileReadInt (the netstart operating mode flag).

nodetx_protocol.shape: named node-request messages over the SonosNet/hwmessage node-comm object (obj+0x6c). Sender FUN_106992d8 (nodetx_vli): FUN_1061e5c0 builds a protobuf-style buffer at obj+0x740, comm->vfunc+0x4c serializes a message at obj+0xb4, then comm->vfunc+0x08('nodetx_vli') sends the named request.
nodetx_protocol.meaning: NodeTXBuffer protobuf req/resp telemetry - per-audio-source node-transmit stats (chsrc=HT-master tx, vli=line-in, ht=home-theatre)
nodetx_protocol.channel: comm->vfunc+0x08(name) = the send/node-request entry point; +0x4c = message serialize. Same node-comm object used for hwmessage events.

internalevts_bus.purpose: in-process publish/subscribe event bus (observer pattern, subject.h) that propagates internal state changes - feeds GENA LastChange and cross-module notification
internalevts_bus.structure: FUN_105bbeac destructor: an event-manager object with 7 event-type slots (obj+0xb..+0x18, stride 3). Each event type = a doubly-linked list of 12-byte subscriber nodes {vtable, prev, next, flag@+0x14}. Teardown unlinks nodes, calls node->vfunc+0x04 (unsubscribe), operator_delete(node,0x18), and logs '%u leaked subscriptions for event %s'.
internalevts_bus.meaning: sat=satellite events, sonar_cal_mode_changed=Trueplay/sonar calibration, avt_device_feedback=AVTransport device feedback, entitlements_changed=music-service entitlement updates - the internal counterpart to the SOAP/GENA external surface
internalevts_bus.vtable: manager obj vtable at 0x10c504b8; event-name table at 0x10c509dc

native_proto_static_bound.method: three independent anchor attempts exhausted: (1) lis+addi code materialization - no refs; (2) data-pointer table search - apparent hits are ASCII false-positives inside GENA error strings ('event source (%s) is only legal for the eventing sub-system', 'Observer "%s" subscribed'); (3) the 'SCI'/'SonosNet'/'snk_'/'src_' hits are SUBSTRINGS of hardware-enum/job names (SCI_BOARD, PSOC, UART, PMU, checkSonosNetDisableTestTimedJob), not protocol entry points
native_proto_static_bound.conclusion: the SCI/SonosNet/MRPC/TLV/nodetx-protocol handler functions are invoked through virtual dispatch and descriptor/registration tables consistent with the binary's pervasive vtable architecture; they are not statically linkable by string or table anchor. Decoding them needs a full virtual-call call-graph reconstruction - beyond string/table static analysis - and/or runtime.
native_proto_static_bound.what_IS_decoded_statically: netstart IPC protocol (ipc_msg.cxx hello/IPC-context), nodetx named node-request shape, internalevts 7-type observer bus, TLV 7-field header format, CHSNK state machine (local chsrc/AI/VLI/remote), fenway-vs-limelight master/satellite protocol split

uri_codec_grammar.codec_type_table: {name,type_code} flat records at m8 0x10c2db80, looked up by FUN_1044ca58 (strcasecmp, returns 1 if known). type codes:
uri_codec_grammar.uri_classifier: FUN_1012a590: rejects streaming schemes first (x-rincon-mp3radio://, mms://, rtsp://, aac://, x-sonosapi-stream/hls/rtrecent: + predicates FUN_10129f28/1012a350/10129b98/1012a010), else extracts scheme token via FUN_10593e94 and validates against the codec table - non-streaming URIs classified by codec.
uri_codec_grammar.scheme_predicates: family of per-scheme prefix-test fns at 0x10129xxx/0x1012axxx (e.g. FUN_101299b8 = 'x-rincon-queue:' strncmp). Recognized schemes include x-rincon:, x-rincon-queue:, x-rincon-cpcontainer:, x-rincon-stream:, x-rincon-mp3radio:, x-file-cifs:, x-sonosapi-stream:, x-sonosapi-hls:, x-sonosapi-rtrecent:, mms://, rtsp://, aac://
uri_codec_grammar.xrincon_payload: x-rincon: URIs embed a device RINCON_id after the scheme (transport handler FUN_10349bfc compares uri+0x5cc/+0x5d5). The transport distinguishes zone-player/self URIs (x-rincon:) from external-stream URIs (parsed via FUN_102fa24c/10663454/102fa478 which also extract a device id for group-addressing). URI storage = 0x401-byte buffer.
uri_codec_grammar.uri_classification_flow: FUN_1012a590: known streaming scheme? -> stream path : else extract scheme token -> codec table -> source-type. x-rincon-queue:->queue, x-rincon-cpcontainer:->CD container, x-rincon-stream:->external stream, x-file-cifs:->local CIFS file, x-rincon-mp3radio:->radio, x-sonosapi-*:->service streams.
